Name: Connecting Bookshelves - AT
Author: skellady
Description:
[size=3]Placing the objects/paintings will randomly pick one of the textures, however, if you'd like to set a specific texture, you'd need to buy the Paint Bucket Tool (added by AT) at Robin's shop. To use the paint bucket, click on the object while equipping the bucket and pick the texture of your choice. For more information on this tool, check PeacefulEnd's wiki [url=https://github.com/Floogen/AlternativeTextures/wiki/Paint-Bucket-Tool]here[/url]. 
[/size]
[size=3]I was working on some maps for Sunberry Village and got upset that we can't use the bookshelves from the library in the farmhouse/sheds, and so, this mod was born.[/size]

[size=3]The furniture you can use: 

- Ceramic Pillar
- Gold Pillar
- Totem Pole
- Industrial Pipe
- Indoor Palm
- Topiary Tree
- Green Serpent Statue
- Manicured Pine
- Tree Column",
- Purple Serpent Statue
- Long Cactus
- Iridium Krobus

The colors for the bookshelves match my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11110]Cabinets, Cupboards, and Closets[/url] mod.

Installation:

1. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] 
2. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]
3. Install the mod (manual download is recommended over Vortex)
4. Unzip the file and place it in your Mods folder[/size]

Downloads.Description: Unzip into your Mods folder. Check description for guide on furniture to replace.
